title: Successful Login With Correct Credentials and RBAC Enforcement
description: Verify user can log in successfully with valid email and password, and appropriate dashboard is displayed based on role-based access control (RBAC).

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter a valid email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify login is successful and user is redirected to the dashboard relevant to their role.
Verify RBAC permissions restrict access to unauthorized modules/features.

title: Login Failure With Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify the system prevents login when invalid email or password is supplied and provides appropriate error message.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid or incorrect email and/or password.
Click the login button.
Verify login is rejected and an error message about invalid credentials is displayed.

title: MikroTik Router Bandwidth Management - Apply Bandwidth Limit
description: Verify that network administrators can successfully apply bandwidth limits on connected MikroTik routers and changes reflect on the router.

steps.description: Log in as network administrator.
Navigate to MikroTik router bandwidth management interface.
Set a bandwidth limit value for a selected user or profile.
Save and apply the settings.
Verify that the bandwidth limit is successfully applied on the MikroTik router.
Verify that the system reflects the updated bandwidth limit values.

title: PPPoE Profile Handling and Synchronization With Router
description: Verify creation, modification, and deletion of PPPoE profiles in the system reflect correctly on MikroTik routers.

steps.description: Log in as network administrator.
Navigate to PPP profile management.
Create a new PPPoE profile with specific parameters.
Verify new profile is added to MikroTik router configuration.
Modify parameters of the created PPPoE profile.
Verify modifications are updated on the router.
Delete the PPPoE profile.
Verify profile is removed from the router.

title: Automated Invoice Generation on Schedule
description: Verify system automatically generates and sends invoices to customers on scheduled dates without errors.

steps.description: Ensure there are customers with active subscriptions requiring billing.
Trigger or wait for the scheduled automated invoice generation cron job.
Verify invoices are generated without errors for all applicable customers.
Verify invoices are delivered to customer accounts and via configured communication channels.

title: Payment Gateway Callback Updates Billing Status
description: Verify that payment statuses update in real-time upon receiving callbacks from Midtrans and Xendit payment gateways.

steps.description: Simulate payment via Midtrans/Xendit payment gateway.
Receive callback notification from payment gateway.
Verify the billing status updates accordingly in the system (paid, failed, pending).
Verify related financial records reflect updated payment status.

title: Employee Attendance Check-In within Geofence
description: Verify employees can only check in and check out successfully when within geofenced area defined for the site.

steps.description: Log in as an employee.
Attempt to check in from within the geofenced location.
Verify check-in is successful and attendance is recorded.
Attempt to check in from outside the geofenced location.
Verify check-in is rejected with an appropriate error message.

title: Accurate Overtime Calculation and Recording
description: Verify system correctly calculates overtime hours based on employee shift records and attendance logs.

steps.description: Log in as HR manager.
Review the shift schedules and attendance for employees.
Verify overtime calculation matches expected values based on attendance outside scheduled shift hours.
Verify overtime is recorded accurately in payroll processing.

title: Role-Based Access Restrictions Prevent Unauthorized Actions
description: Verify that users without permissions cannot access or perform restricted operations in the system.

steps.description: Log in as a low-privilege user (e.g., employee or guest).
Attempt to access restricted modules or administrative features.
Verify access is denied and appropriate error or warning messages are shown.
Attempt restricted operations via API calls.
Verify the system rejects unauthorized actions and logs them if applicable.

title: Inventory and Procurement Record Update and Traceability
description: Verify that inventory changes and procurement workflows update records accurately and provide full traceability.

steps.description: Log in as inventory manager.
Add new hardware asset to inventory.
Verify the new asset entry is saved with correct details and timestamp.
Initiate a procurement request for assets.
Approve and process the procurement request.
Verify procurement status updates properly and all associated records including supplier details are tracked.

title: Work Order Ticket Lifecycle States and Status Notifications
description: Verify work order tickets transition correctly through their lifecycle states and notifications are triggered timely.

steps.description: Log in as field technician.
Create a new work order ticket.
Verify ticket is created with correct details and initial status.
Update ticket status through stages like assigned, in progress, resolved, and closed.
Verify each status update triggers notifications via configured channels on time.

title: Real-Time Network Infrastructure Monitoring Updates
description: Verify real-time updates and correct visualization of network infrastructure status including router health and bandwidth usage on maps.

steps.description: Log in as network administrator.
Navigate to geographic network monitoring dashboard.
Verify live status of routers and bandwidth usage is displayed accurately and refreshed in real time.
Verify map interactions such as zoom, pan, and layer toggling function correctly.

title: Internal Announcement Creation and Multi-Channel Notification Dispatch
description: Verify managers can create internal announcements and system dispatches notifications via WhatsApp, Email, and Web Push to targeted users.

steps.description: Log in as manager.
Create a new internal announcement with title, message, and target audience.
Publish the announcement.
Verify announcement appears in users’ announcement feeds.
Verify notifications are sent successfully over WhatsApp, Email, and Web Push to targeted recipients.

title: Automated Cron Job Executes Scheduled Billing and Backup Tasks
description: Verify scheduled cron jobs for billing invoice generation and system backups execute reliably without failures or errors.

steps.description: Check cron job schedule configurations for billing and backups.
Manually trigger or wait for scheduled cron jobs.
Verify billing cron job generates invoices correctly and updates billing status.
Verify backup cron job completes successfully and backup artifacts are available.
Verify system logs record the successful execution and no errors occur.

title: Finance Report Generation and Accuracy
description: Verify managers can generate comprehensive financial reports reflecting accurate billing, payment, and invoice data.

steps.description: Log in as finance manager.
Navigate to financial reports section.
Generate reports for specified date ranges and billing categories.
Verify generated reports display accurate aggregated financial data including customer payments and invoices.
